scenes.title: Lift the Handle
scenes.summary: Kavya arrives early for her first morning shift at Courtyard Haveli, and Pratap shows her the front-door trick and his paper register.

scenes.title: Warm Rolls and Two Rings
scenes.summary: Morning baker Diya welcomes Kavya with fresh warm buns, invites her to drop formal 'aap', and explains Room 4's phantom double ring.

scenes.title: Where Are My Glasses?
scenes.summary: Anxious owner Mohan hurries in fretting over Room 4's week-long guest while hunting for the glasses resting on his own forehead.

scenes.title: Room Four on the Second Floor
scenes.summary: Retired piano teacher Sudha checks into Room 4 after a peaceful morning train ride, puzzled by how heavy her dark-blue suitcase feels.

scenes.title: Not My Clothes!
scenes.summary: Upstairs in Room 4, Sudha opens the dark-blue suitcase and finds men's brown shoes, grey sweaters, and a small wooden toy train instead of her things.

scenes.title: The Luggage Tag
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Mohan reads two initials and a nearby Jaipur lane on the luggage tag while Kavya phones the station lost-and-found office.

scenes.title: Tea and a Warm Cardigan
scenes.summary: Diya pours hot mint tea with honey and lends Sudha a soft unworn wool cardigan while Pratap locks the mystery suitcase in the luggage closet.

scenes.title: Left on the Step
scenes.summary: At nine o'clock at night the courtyard gate bell rings, and Kavya and Pratap find Sudha's real suitcase on the stone step with an unsigned note.
